name: Currency Converter Calculator
tagline: Convert currencies with a calculator built in
description:
This app converts between most of the currencies used around the world, and lets you do the arithmetic in the same place — add up a few numbers and convert the result, without switching to a separate calculator.

Rates come from the project's own server rather than from a public rates website. The same app is published for iPhone, so both phones in a household behave the same way.

The published builds carry adverts. Paying for Premium switches them off, but it runs out after a set period rather than for good, and the home screen widget is Premium-only as well. If you build the app yourself, the rate server's address is not published, so conversions will not work until you point it at a server of your own.
